main_answer_reason: Covers both batches, possession dates, the trial/District Judge/High Court contrast and proposed munafa grounds, but omits the earlier additional-rent adjudications, initial deduction pleadings and detailed accounting directions. It misattributes the first-batch 1910 chronology and speculates about High Court reasoning not given in the excerpts.

reference_objections.objection: D15 requires the reported assessment-date cutoff and preservation of its textual ambiguity, overlapping D57’s independent uncertainty criterion. The report gives the assessment cutoff once but later gives an unreconciled general possession cutoff, making D15 satisfaction ambiguous.
